description: This file defines common reusable Flutter widgets, including CardShell for card layouts with optional header content and loading states, and EmptyState for displaying empty content messages with optional compact mode.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A reusable surfaced card container with Ocean theme feel, supporting optional header elements and loading states.

classes.name: _LoadingBar
classes.description: A private widget representing a loading placeholder bar used within CardShell.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget for displaying empty state messages, with optional compact layout.

methods.name: CardShell.loadingOrChild
methods.description: Returns a CardShell with a shimmer-like loading placeholder or the provided child widget.

methods.name: CardShell.build
methods.description: Builds the CardShell widget layout with optional icon, title, action, and content.

methods.name: _LoadingBar.build
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of the loading bar.

methods.name: EmptyState.build
methods.description: Builds the widget for the empty state message, either compact or full layout.
